queries.query:
MATCH (u:User {email: $email})
RETURN
  u.passwd_hash AS passwd_hash,
  u.email AS email,
  u.idx AS idx,
  u:Inactive AS inactive,
  u:Admin AS admin,
  u:Teacher AS teacher,
  u:Student AS student

SELECT
  u.passwd_hash,
  u.email,
  u.idx,
  i.idx IS NOT NULL AS inactive,
  a.idx IS NOT NULL AS admin,
  t.idx IS NOT NULL AS teacher,
  s.idx IS NOT NULL AS student
FROM app_user u
LEFT JOIN inactive i ON i.idx = u.idx
LEFT JOIN admin a ON a.idx = u.idx
LEFT JOIN teacher t ON t.idx = u.idx
LEFT JOIN student s ON s.idx = u.idx
WHERE u.email = %(email)s

MATCH (ac:AcademicCycle)
RETURN ac.id AS id, ac.year AS year, ac.season AS season
SELECT id, year, season FROM academic_cycle

SELECT
  su.code,
  su.name,
  se.ects,
  ARRAY(
    SELECT DISTINCT fa.name
    FROM term_subject ts
    JOIN curriculum_term ct ON ct.id = ts.term_id
    JOIN curriculum c ON c.id = ct.curriculum_id
    JOIN programme p ON p.id = c.programme_id
    JOIN faculty fa ON fa.id = p.faculty_id
    WHERE ts.subject_code = su.code
  ) AS faculties,
  ARRAY(
    SELECT json_build_object(
      'offered', EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM term_subject ts
        JOIN taught_in ti ON ti.term_id = ts.term_id
        WHERE ts.subject_code = su.code AND ti.cycle_id = cyc.id
      ),
      'group_count', (
        SELECT count(*)
        FROM group_type gt
        JOIN class_group g ON g.group_type_id = gt.id
        WHERE gt.subject_code = su.code AND gt.cycle_id = cyc.id
      ),
      -- A registration has no dates of its own: its period runs from the start of its first
      -- turn to the end of its last one.
      'registration_open', EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM group_type gt
        JOIN class_group g ON g.group_type_id = gt.id
        JOIN opens o ON o.group_id = g.id
        JOIN registration_turn rt ON rt.registration_id = o.registration_id
        WHERE gt.subject_code = su.code AND gt.cycle_id = cyc.id
        GROUP BY o.registration_id
        HAVING min((rt.date + rt.start_time) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Warsaw') <= now()
           AND now() < max((rt.date + rt.end_time) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Warsaw')
      )
    )
    FROM unnest(%(cycle_ids)s::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS cyc (id, ord)
    ORDER BY cyc.ord
  ) AS cycles
FROM subject su
LEFT JOIN subject_ects se ON se.subject_code = su.code
WHERE (%(name)s::text IS NULL OR strpos(lower(su.name), lower(%(name)s)) > 0)
  AND (%(code)s::text IS NULL OR strpos(lower(su.code), lower(%(code)s)) > 0)
ORDER BY su.name COLLATE "C"

MATCH (t:Teacher {idx: $teacher_idx})<-[:ABOUT_TEACHER]-(o:Opinion)-[:ABOUT]->(g:Group)
WHERE $group_id IS NULL OR g.id = $group_id

MATCH (g)-[:OF_TYPE]->(gt:GroupType)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(si:SubjectInstance)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(su:Subject)
MATCH (si)-[:OFFERED_IN]->(ac:AcademicCycle)
RETURN
  o.id AS id,
  o.grade AS grade,
  o.content AS content,
  date(o.submit) AS submit,
  g.id AS group_id,
  su.code AS course_code,
  su.name AS course_name,
  gt.g_type AS g_type,
  ac.year + " " + ac.season AS cycle,
  t.idx AS teacher_idx,
  t.name + " " + t.surname AS teacher
ORDER BY o.submit DESC

SELECT
  o.id,
  o.grade::float8 AS grade,
  oc.content,
  -- Only the day: with the exact time a teacher could match an opinion to a student of a small group.
  (o.submit AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Warsaw')::date AS submit,
  g.id AS group_id,
  su.code AS course_code,
  su.name AS course_name,
  gt.g_type,
  ac.year || ' ' || ac.season AS cycle,
  tp.idx AS teacher_idx,
  tp.name || ' ' || tp.surname AS teacher
FROM opinion o
LEFT JOIN opinion_content oc ON oc.opinion_id = o.id
JOIN class_group g ON g.id = o.group_id
JOIN person tp ON tp.idx = o.teacher_idx
JOIN group_type gt ON gt.id = g.group_type_id
JOIN subject su ON su.code = gt.subject_code
JOIN academic_cycle ac ON ac.id = gt.cycle_id

WHERE o.teacher_idx = %(teacher_idx)s
  AND (%(group_id)s::text IS NULL OR o.group_id = %(group_id)s)
ORDER BY o.submit DESC

MATCH (st:Student {idx: $student_idx})-[:ASSIGNED]->(:RegistrationTurn)<-[:HAS_TURN]-(reg:Registration {id: $registration_id})
RETURN reg.id AS id

MATCH (st:Student {idx: $student_idx})
        MATCH (reg:Registration {id: $registration_id})-[:OPENS]->(g:Group)
        MATCH (g)-[:OF_TYPE]->(gt:GroupType)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(:SubjectInstance)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(:Subject {code: $subject_code})
        OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[:IN_ROOM]->(r:Room)
        OPTIONAL MATCH (t:Teacher)-[:TEACHES]->(g)
        OPTIONAL MATCH (st)-[mine:REGISTERED_IN]->(g)
        RETURN
          g.id AS id,
          gt.g_type AS g_type,
          g.number AS number,
          g.weekday AS weekday,
          g.start_time AS start,
          g.end_time AS end,
          g.capacity AS capacity,
          size([(g)<-[:REGISTERED_IN]-() | 1]) AS filled,
          r.building + " " + r.room_num AS room,
          t.name + " " + t.surname AS teacher,
          mine IS NOT NULL AS registered
        ORDER BY gt.g_type, g.number

SELECT registration_id AS id
FROM assigned
WHERE student_idx = %(student_idx)s AND registration_id = %(registration_id)s

SELECT
  g.id,
  gt.g_type,
  g.number,
  g.weekday,
  g.start_time AS start,
  g.end_time AS "end",
  g.capacity,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM registered_in ri WHERE ri.group_id = g.id) AS filled,
  r.building || ' ' || r.room_num AS room,
  tp.name || ' ' || tp.surname AS teacher,
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM registered_in ri
    WHERE ri.group_id = g.id AND ri.student_idx = %(student_idx)s
  ) AS registered
FROM opens o
JOIN class_group g ON g.id = o.group_id
JOIN group_type gt ON gt.id = g.group_type_id
LEFT JOIN in_room ir ON ir.group_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN room r ON r.id = ir.room_id
LEFT JOIN teaches te ON te.group_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN person tp ON tp.idx = te.teacher_idx
WHERE o.registration_id = %(registration_id)s
  AND gt.subject_code = %(subject_code)s
ORDER BY gt.g_type COLLATE "C", g.number

MATCH (t:Teacher {idx: $teacher_idx})-[:TEACHES]->(g:Group {id: $group_id})
            RETURN g.id AS id

MATCH (g:Group {id: $group_id})
        MATCH (st:Student)-[r:REGISTERED_IN]->(g)
        RETURN
          st.idx AS idx,
          st.name AS name,
          st.surname AS surname,
          st.phone AS phone,
          st.photo AS photo,
          st.joined AS joined,
          r.grade AS grade
        ORDER BY st.surname, st.name

SELECT group_id AS id FROM teaches
WHERE teacher_idx = %(teacher_idx)s AND group_id = %(group_id)s

SELECT
  p.idx,
  p.name,
  p.surname,
  p.phone,
  ph.photo,
  s.joined,
  gr.grade::float8 AS grade
FROM registered_in ri
JOIN student s ON s.idx = ri.student_idx
JOIN person p ON p.idx = s.idx
LEFT JOIN person_photo ph ON ph.idx = p.idx
LEFT JOIN grade gr ON gr.student_idx = ri.student_idx AND gr.group_id = ri.group_id
WHERE ri.group_id = %(group_id)s
ORDER BY p.surname COLLATE "C", p.name COLLATE "C"

MATCH (t:Teacher {idx: $teacher_idx})-[:TEACHES]->(:Group)<-[:REGISTERED_IN]-(st:Student {idx: $student_idx})
            RETURN st.idx AS idx

MATCH (st:Student {idx: $student_idx})
RETURN
  st.idx AS idx,
  st.name AS name,
  st.surname AS surname,
  st.phone AS phone,
  st.photo AS photo,
  st.joined AS joined,
  COLLECT { MATCH (st)-[:ENROLLED]->(ct:CurriculumTerm) RETURN ct.id } AS term_ids

MATCH (st:Student {idx: $student_idx})-[:REGISTERED_IN]->(:Group)-[:OF_TYPE]->(:GroupType)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(si:SubjectInstance)
WITH DISTINCT st, si
MATCH (si)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(su:Subject)
MATCH (si)-[:OFFERED_IN]->(ac:AcademicCycle)
MATCH (si)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(gt:GroupType)
OPTIONAL MATCH (st)-[r:REGISTERED_IN]->(:Group)-[:OF_TYPE]->(gt)
RETURN
  su.code AS subject,
  su.ects AS ects,
  ac.year AS year,
  ac.season AS season,
  gt.id AS type,
  gt.weight AS weight,
  r.grade AS grade

SELECT ri.student_idx AS idx
FROM teaches te
JOIN registered_in ri ON ri.group_id = te.group_id
WHERE te.teacher_idx = %(teacher_idx)s AND ri.student_idx = %(student_idx)s
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  p.idx,
  p.name,
  p.surname,
  p.phone,
  ph.photo,
  s.joined,
  ARRAY(SELECT e.term_id FROM enrolled e WHERE e.student_idx = s.idx) AS term_ids
FROM student s
JOIN person p ON p.idx = s.idx
LEFT JOIN person_photo ph ON ph.idx = p.idx
WHERE s.idx = %(student_idx)s

SELECT
  su.code AS subject,
  se.ects,
  ac.year,
  ac.season,
  gt.id AS type,
  gt.weight,
  mine.grade::float8 AS grade
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT gt0.subject_code, gt0.cycle_id
  FROM registered_in ri
  JOIN class_group g ON g.id = ri.group_id
  JOIN group_type gt0 ON gt0.id = g.group_type_id
  WHERE ri.student_idx = %(student_idx)s
) si
JOIN subject su ON su.code = si.subject_code
LEFT JOIN subject_ects se ON se.subject_code = su.code
JOIN academic_cycle ac ON ac.id = si.cycle_id
JOIN group_type gt ON gt.subject_code = si.subject_code AND gt.cycle_id = si.cycle_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT gr.grade, g.group_type_id
  FROM grade gr
  JOIN class_group g ON g.id = gr.group_id
  WHERE gr.student_idx = %(student_idx)s
) mine ON mine.group_type_id = gt.id

MATCH (t:Teacher {idx: $teacher_idx})-[:TEACHES]->(g:Group {id: $group_id})
            RETURN g.id AS id

MATCH (st:Student {idx: $student_idx})-[r:REGISTERED_IN]->(g:Group {id: $group_id})
        SET r.grade = $grade
        RETURN g.id AS group_id, st.idx AS student_idx, r.grade AS grade

SELECT group_id AS id FROM teaches
WHERE teacher_idx = %(teacher_idx)s AND group_id = %(group_id)s

INSERT INTO grade (student_idx, group_id, grade)
SELECT student_idx, group_id, %(grade)s
FROM registered_in
WHERE student_idx = %(student_idx)s AND group_id = %(group_id)s
ON CONFLICT (student_idx, group_id) DO UPDATE SET grade = excluded.grade
RETURNING group_id, student_idx, grade::float8 AS grade
